pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition on scaling into a position when the original entry is experiencing floating drawdown; scaling is only permitted after the initial position has achieved a 1:1 risk-to-reward ratio and moved the stop-loss to breakeven.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require a validated 3-tick volume-weighted imbalance confirmation and a zero-cross on the short-term MACD momentum oscillator before order execution to avoid false breakout wicks.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate aggressive trailing exits and partial profit captures the moment unrealized gains cross $12.00 to guarantee the $15-$30+ asymmetry target.
